turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
Found where? And who is "we"?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
Eleven thirty-one. A file being created isn't the same as it being written, and Owen wrote it over the weekend. Was he asked about it before the zero went in, or is that in writing somewhere?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
Pasted from where? People paste their own notes. I want that history on paper, and you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
I'm not here for your respect. Where is the history, and who spoke to Owen before the zero?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A wrong line is a misquotation, and students misquote Hamlet every year. Put the page with that line in front of me and I'll look it up myself. Then you can tell me who spoke to Owen before the zero.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Flattery isn't a document. The page with that line on it, Hale.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
Changing your argument between an outline and a final draft is called revising. Show me the outline and the essay side by side. And I still haven't heard whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.
A machine's guess. Your own procedure says software doesn't establish a concern, and the company that sells it says not to rest on it alone. Put the document history on paper in front of me.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Are you asking me how to do your job? There's no off the record in this room. The document history, on paper, Hale.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
That's 4.4, and it goes in writing or it doesn't exist. But I haven't seen one page yet, so a rewrite for what? Show me the history, the outline and the essay, then we talk about a rewrite.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? You're the one who called this meeting about Owen's essay. The pages, now.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
Take it to whoever you like; I'm going to the principal either way. And a zero held over my son's head until I agree to something goes in writing. Show me the pages.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. The zero comes off, and you show me the pages.
